budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Serve six correct recipes at each of five kitchens, using finite pantry stock and shared lifts while controlling spoilage and power use.
task.natural_termination: Joint natural completion when all five kitchen delivery counters reach six. Otherwise H=640 ends the shift; all twenty cooks remain active until joint completion.
task.interaction: Loading opens a real landing barrier that a different cook must secure. Freezers share paired-floor power with ovens and lift departures. Items, tickets, hot meals and dirty dishes physically travel in hands or lift cabins.
task.observation_access: The exact self fields, finite nearest-entity slots, local map patch and public clock are the only flat observations. Entity slots sort by Manhattan distance then ID; all columns of a hidden slot are -1. Actor rendering also exposes the selected actor through its self block even if crowding removes it from nearest-eight slots. The static map layout is public. Forecast/knowledge leaves are private unless explicitly observed or messaged. Masks expose local contextual affordances. Event rendering must inherit its owning entity visibility and cannot display hidden global vectors. No renderer state is an extra policy observation.

native_event_definitions.meaning: accepted action code for the last actual transition; not a success flag
carried food spoiled in last transition
landing safety barrier open and blocks entry

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
